title: Session feature rows
description: One-row-per-UTC-trading-day session features, written by a heisentick research export (scripts/research/vpSessionCorrelation.mjs --rows-out) for consumption by heisentick-ml and other offline research repositories. The engine is the single source of truth for every indicator/level here (volume profile, POC, value area); consumers must not re-derive them from raw bars. Every field on a row is computable using only bars timestamped strictly before that row's decisionTs, with one exception: londonOpen is the open price of the first bar at or after decisionTs, i.e. the decision reference price itself, not a look-ahead value. This document carries features only; outcome/label columns (what happened after decisionTs) are a research concern and are computed downstream in Python, never written here.

asiaStartHourUtc.description: Asia window start, UTC hour. The window is [asiaStartHourUtc, asiaEndHourUtc).

londonStartHourUtc.description: The London decision hour, UTC. Each row's decisionTs is this hour on that row's date. Every feature on the row uses only bars strictly before decisionTs.

valueAreaPercent.description: Target value-area percentage used to compute vah/val.

sessionRows.description: Volume-profile row count used for the Asia-session profile.

dayRows.description: Volume-profile row count used for the prior-day profile.

minAsiaBars.description: Minimum bars required inside the Asia window for a day to be kept.

version.description: engine/package.json version at export time, when available.

gitSha.description: heisentick repository commit the export ran from, when available.

dataFile.description: Path or filename of the bar data the rows were computed from, as reported by the loader (e.g. "5m.json" or "5m.bin"). Not a contract-wide s3Key: this file is local/offline, never uploaded.

sha256.description: sha256 of the source data file's bytes, when computed.

date.description: UTC calendar date this row's Asia session and decision belong to.

decisionTs.description: London decision timestamp: this date at sessionConfig.londonStartHourUtc, UTC.

asia.description: Summary and volume-profile levels of the Asia window bars, all strictly before decisionTs.

poc.description: Point of control price of the Asia-window volume profile.

delta.description: Up-volume minus down-volume across the Asia window (engine/volumeProfile.js upVolume - downVolume).

londonOpen.description: Open price of the first bar at or after decisionTs. The decision reference price; not a look-ahead field.

priorDay.description: Prior UTC day's high/low and volume-profile levels, all fully in the past relative to decisionTs. null when the prior day could not be computed (e.g. no prior-day bars available) - the row is otherwise still emitted.

features.description: Categorical buckets, named exactly as scripts/research/vpSessionCorrelation.mjs computes them. null means the underlying comparison was undefined for this row (for example a zero-range session), not that the feature is unsupported.
